title: Canonical localized semilinear transitions of strict coefficient systems
statement: Let $(\mathcal C,J)$ be a site [def-weil-pbc-sites-and-cohomology] and let $B:\mathbf N^{op}\to\operatorname{Sh}(\mathcal C,\operatorname{CommRing})$ be an inverse sequence [def-weil-inverse-system] of sheaves of commutative rings. Use the category $\mathscr S(B)$ of strict semilinear systems, its exact evaluations $e_n$ and scalar-restriction functors $r_{n,m}:\operatorname{Mod}(B_m)\to\operatorname{Mod}(B_n)$ for $m\le n$ from [def-pur-system-level-left-extension-basic]. The module categories are [def-weil-sheaf-of-modules-category] and scalar restriction is [def-pc-sheaf-restrict-scalars]. Use the unbounded derived categories and their localization functors $Q$ [def-weil-abstract-derived-category]. Define the actual derived transition $\delta_{n,m}:D(e_n)\Rightarrow D(r_{n,m})\circ D(e_m)$ by localizing the degreewise strict transition $e_n\Rightarrow r_{n,m}\circ e_m$ through $Q$, then composing with the canonical exact-functor composition isomorphism $D(r_{n,m}\circ e_m)\cong D(r_{n,m})\circ D(e_m)$. This definition applies to every $m\le n$, including $m=n$; natural-number index $n$ denotes positive level $n+1$.
